items.title: FlexiNeck
items.subtitle: Architecture de vision neuronale adaptative conçue from scratch.
items.readmeDesc: FlexiNeck is a modular and configurable neck architecture for computer vision tasks, acting as a feature aggregation layer between the backbone and heads. It combines FPN, PAN, SPP, and Attention mechanisms to aggregate multi-scale features and enhance representations for detection, segmentation, and classification.
